name: Ruins

rounds.endCondition: Win instantly by going out first when starting a round with 9 or 10 VP; otherwise showdown round 5

categories.label: VP per round (finish position)
categories.labelVi: VP mỗi ván (theo thứ tự về đích)
categories.hint: Enter VP gained or lost for this round from the scoreboard chart (printed on the board by player count; last place loses VP). Track floors at 0 and caps at 10.

categories.label: Won by going out first (instant or showdown)
categories.labelVi: Thắng nhờ hết bài đầu tiên
categories.hint: Check for the winner: first out when starting with 9-10 VP, or first out in round 5.

tiebreakers.description: No score tiebreak: the winner is whoever goes out first under the instant-win or round-5 showdown rule.

notes: family: climbing-shedding. Per-finishing-position VP values are printed on the scoreboard graphic, not in the rulebook text, so they are entered by the scorer each round. VP track floors at 0 (ignore negative VP at 0) and caps at 10 (you cannot gain more; you must go out first to win). Round ends when only one player has cards left; that player scores the last-place VP. Next first player is whoever has fewest VP (ties: furthest clockwise from previous first player). 2-3 player games cover the top scoring chart with the scoring tile. Rulebook verified against the Allplay PDF.

endCondition.description: Instant win: start any round with 9-10 VP and go out first. Otherwise showdown in round 5 after round 4, first out wins.

winCondition: Go out first while starting the round with 9 or 10 VP (instant win), or win the round-5 showdown by going out first (played by the player(s) with most VP after round 4 and the player who went out first in round 4). Score totals alone do not decide the winner.
